# Synthetic DataForSEO-shaped T01 fixtures

No file here is a live capture or medical evidence. `success.json` is hand-written
synthetic German/emoji content with repeated numbered markers, ordinary Markdown
links, captured excerpts, and an unknown field. It follows the public AI Mode Live
Advanced envelope/element shape, not an Organic SERP response.

Tests construct explicit variants from these saved bytes: empty/missing/null source
metadata, ordinary links, malformed entries, absent/blank aggregate Markdown,
unknown structures, HTTP/envelope/task errors, costs, and transport failures. This
keeps one auditable envelope rather than copying nearly identical synthetic files.

References inspected (19 September 2026):
- https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/serp/google/ai_mode/live/advanced/
- https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/appendix/errors/
- https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/serp/google/ai_mode/languages/

The `[[n]](URL)` marker shape is visible in the endpoint's public example. T01's
parser deliberately handles only a conservative subset; this fixture does not
establish completeness of provider citation capture or live German support.
